text:
Iko Mba Ụwa FIFA nke 2014 weghachiri asọmpi ahụ na Brazil, ebe obibi mmụọ nke egwuregwu, ebe otu 32 gbakọtara site na 12 June ruo 13 July 2014. Ụdị ya jikọtara ọkwa otu nke otu asatọ nke anọ na agba nkwụsị otu nke na-aga site na agba nke 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu maka ọnọdụ nke atọ na ikpeazụ. N’egwuregwu 64 niile, asọmpi ahụ dọtara ngụkọta ndị bịara 3,429,873, nkezi nke 53,592 kwa egwuregwu.

Asọmpi ahụ mebiri n’ụzọ siri ike ihe a tụrụ anya. Ndị mmeri nchebe Spain ka ewepụrụ n’ọkwa otu, na-akwụsị oge nke butere ha na mmeri gara aga. Mgbasa ozi mba nnabata dara n’ụzọ pụrụ iche: Germany meriri Brazil 7–1 n’ọkara ikpeazụ, otu n’ime nsonaazụ kacha sie ike n’akụkọ Iko Mba Ụwa, ebe Brazil mechara bụrụ nke anọ, n’azụ Netherlands nke nwetara ọnọdụ nke atọ.

Nsonaazụ ahụ kpọgara Germany n’ikpeazụ megide Argentina n’ama egwuregwu Maracanã dị na Rio de Janeiro. Egwuregwu ahụ kwụsịrị n’oge mgbakwunye, mgbe onye nnọchi Mario Götze jikwaa ma gbaa bọọlụ n’ụkwụ n’oge nkeji 113 iji merie ya 1–0. Site n’ọkpụkpụ ahụ ọ ghọrọ onye nnọchi mbụ gbara goolu mmeri n’ikpeazụ Iko Mba Ụwa. Germany ghọrọ ndị mmeri nke ugboro anọ, ma n’welite iko ahụ bụ otu mba Europe mbụ meriri Iko Mba Ụwa e mere na Americas—mmeri nke atọ n’usoro maka mba Europe mgbe Italy na 2006 na Spain na 2010 gasịrị.

Nsọpụrụ onye ọ bụla kesara n’ofe ama egwuregwu. James Rodríguez nke Colombia nwetara Golden Boot dị ka onye kacha gbaa goolu isii, ebe ọkpụkpụ ya megide Uruguay mechara nweta FIFA Puskás Award maka goolu nke afọ; Thomas Müller nke Germany bịara nke abụọ n’ọsọ goolu ahụ na goolu ise. Lionel Messi nke Argentina nke bịara nke abụọ ka a kpọrọ onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma, na-anata adidas Golden Ball. Asọmpi ahụ gosikwara ihe ọhụrụ abụọ maka asọmpi ahụ: ọ bụ Iko Mba Ụwa mbụ jiri teknụzụ ahịrị goolu na nke mbụ jiri ịfụfụ na-apụ n’anya maka ịkụ aka n’efu.
